summary.title: DevOps capabilities | Google Cloud Documentation
summary.one_liner: This page is an index of DORA's validated DevOps capabilities, grouped into technical, process, and cultural categories, each linking to a dedicated guide.
takeaways: DORA identified a set of technical, process, and cultural capabilities that drive higher software delivery and organizational performance.
Technical capabilities include continuous delivery, continuous integration, test automation, trunk-based development, and version control.
Process capabilities include streamlining change approval with peer review, working in small batches, and limiting work in process.
Cultural capabilities include generative organizational culture, job satisfaction, learning culture, and transformational leadership.
This page is a navigation index; the detailed guidance lives in the linked articles.
summary.summary: This Google Cloud documentation page is an index of the DevOps capabilities validated by the DORA team as drivers of higher software delivery and organizational performance. It lists 13 technical capabilities, 9 process capabilities, and 4 cultural capabilities, each with a one-line description. The trunk-based development entry describes preventing merge-conflict problems with trunk-based practices. The page itself gives no detailed how-to content; each capability links to its own article.
